title.zh: SEC Proposes Last-Resort Crypto Self-Custody for Advisers and Funds
title.en: SEC Proposes Last-Resort Crypto Self-Custody for Advisers and Funds

current_state.zh: The SEC proposed allowing registered investment advisers and funds to use last-resort crypto self-custody arrangements, potentially reshaping how institutional clients hold digital assets under custody rules.
current_state.en: The SEC proposed allowing registered investment advisers and funds to use last-resort crypto self-custody arrangements, potentially reshaping how institutional clients hold digital assets under custody rules.
